title: Saint Mark Preaching in Alexandria by Gentile and Giovanni Bellini
episode: Ottomans & Venetians: Gentile Bellini, Saint Mark Preaching in Alexandria
description: A huge canvas begun by Gentile Bellini, who had worked at the Ottoman court in Istanbul, and finished by his brother Giovanni, filled with turbans, camels, and an imagined Alexandria. It is in the Brera.
